dct_description_sm: Population Raster Cook Islands 2020 Data Input: Settlement footprint from Facebook's High-Resolution Population Density Maps https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cook-islands-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates Population allocated proportionally using 2011 census population counts at enumeration area level. Year Population Growth Rate of 0.23% has been applied to update population up to 2020 The human settlement footprint with census population allocated has been converted into a 100 m resolution raster. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/cok_population_grid_2020)_
